name: Benjamin Netanyahu
role: Prime Minister of Israel (2022–present); concluded corruption-trial testimony Jun 24, 2026 after 98 hearings; Knesset dissolved Jul 17 ahead of Oct 27, 2026 election; government told High Court Jul 22 it will not pass October 7 probe legislation before the election
quote: The attack on Justice Sohlberg's home is completely unacceptable. I condemn it in the strongest terms. [June 4, 2026 — after Haredi rioters attacked Supreme Court Deputy President Sohlberg's home. Earlier, May 12, 2026: 'Everybody bears some responsibility, from the prime minister down.' — CBS 60 Minutes, first explicit partial self-inclusion in October 7 culpability while blocking the independent commission 63–72% of Israelis demand. On June 24, 2026, Netanyahu concluded his own corruption-trial testimony after 98 hearings, calling the prosecution 'a decade of hell.' On July 6, 2026, his coalition pushed the Kallner October 7 inquiry bill — a politically-appointed, no-judges commission — through its first reading 59-0 amid a total opposition boycott, explicitly to preserve it under the Knesset's continuity rule rather than pass it into law before the July 17 dissolution. On July 5, 2026, his Cabinet voted unanimously to defy a High Court ruling for the first time in Israeli history (on the broadcast media regulator), while Knesset Speaker Ohana simultaneously refused the court-ordered revote on comptroller Michael Rabello's appointment, leaving Israel with no sitting state comptroller. On July 12, 2026, his coalition confirmed the next election for October 27, 2026 — the first full Knesset term since 1988. The Knesset formally dissolved July 17 without completing the Kallner bill, and on July 22, 2026 the government told the High Court it would not finish October 7 probe legislation before the election, drawing accusations of 'contempt for the court, the rule of law, and the Israeli public' from the October Council of bereaved and hostage families. No independent or political state commission of inquiry into October 7 had been established as of August 9, 2026 (Day 1037).]

name: Ariel Kallner
role: Likud Knesset Member; sponsor of the coalition's October 7 inquiry bill ('Kallner bill'), which passed its first reading 59-0 on July 6, 2026
quote: [No standalone public quote catalogued. Kallner's bill establishes a six-member commission appointed with 80-MK backing or, failing that, a 3-3 coalition/opposition split with judges barred from serving — a structure opposition lawmakers and bereaved-family groups say is designed to ensure political control of the October 7 investigation rather than independent accountability. The bill passed its first reading July 6, 2026 amid a total opposition boycott and now returns to the Knesset Constitution Committee ahead of further readings expected before the Knesset's July 17, 2026 dissolution.]

name: Yoav Gallant
role: Israeli Defense Minister (2022–Nov 2024)
quote: We are fighting human animals and we will act accordingly. Gaza will not return to what it was before October 7.

name: Lt. Gen. Herzi Halevi
role: IDF Chief of Staff (until Jan 2025)
quote: The IDF failed in its most basic mission — to protect the citizens of Israel. I take full responsibility.

name: Ronen Bar
role: Shin Bet Director (until Mar 2025)
quote: The Shin Bet failed in its mission. I bear responsibility for the intelligence failure that allowed October 7 to occur.

name: Benny Gantz
role: National Unity/Opposition Leader; War Cabinet Member (resigned Jun 2024)
quote: Netanyahu is holding up a deal. If the government does not present a clear post-war plan, we will leave the war cabinet.

name: Yahya Sinwar
role: Hamas Leader in Gaza; October 7 Mastermind (killed Oct 16, 2024)
quote: We are the ones who started this war and we know how to end it. Every martyr, every wounded person will open a gate to liberation.

name: Ismail Haniyeh
role: Hamas Political Bureau Chairman (assassinated Jul 31, 2024)
quote: The Al-Aqsa Flood has overturned the equations of the region. Palestine has returned to the center of the world's attention.

name: Mohammed Deif
role: Hamas Military Commander — announced Operation Al-Aqsa Flood
quote: Today, the era of this enemy's rampaging without accountability has ended. Launch thousands of rockets in the first hour.

name: Joe Biden
role: US President (2021–Jan 2025)
quote: The terrorist group Hamas unleashed pure, unadulterated evil. We stand with Israel. Israel has the right to defend itself.

name: Antony Blinken
role: US Secretary of State (2021–Jan 2025)
quote: I come to Israel as an American — but also as a Jew. The United States will always be there for Israel.

name: Donald Trump
role: US President (Jan 2025–present); brokered 20-point Gaza peace plan
quote: We got all the hostages home. Now we need to finish building the peace — a real peace, not the fake peace everyone else tried.

name: António Guterres
role: UN Secretary-General
quote: The attacks by Hamas did not happen in a vacuum. But nothing can justify the deliberate targeting and killing of civilians. International humanitarian law must be respected by all parties.

name: Karim Khan
role: ICC Prosecutor
quote: The law is not a barrier to military action, it is a framework for that action. Arrest warrants have been issued for Netanyahu, Gallant, and Hamas commanders.

name: Pramila Patten
role: UN Special Representative on Sexual Violence in Conflict
quote: There are reasonable grounds to believe that sexual violence including rape and gang rape occurred in multiple locations on October 7 and continues against hostages.

name: Cyril Ramaphosa
role: South African President — filed ICJ genocide case
quote: South Africa has approached the ICJ because the scale of Israel's actions in Gaza constitutes genocide. We have an obligation under international law to act.

name: Itamar Ben Gvir
role: Israeli National Security Minister; Far-Right Coalition Partner. May 23, 2026: Banned from France (and Poland) over 'unspeakable' flotilla activist taunting video — Netanyahu said conduct 'not in line with Israel's values' but kept him in cabinet
quote: These are terrorists helping murderers. I ordered the October 7 horror video screened to them. Anyone who tries to break our blockade supporting Hamas will see exactly what Hamas did.

name: Bezalel Smotrich
role: Israeli Finance Minister; Far-Right Coalition Partner
quote: The State of Israel will not allow a Palestinian state. The correct solution is voluntary emigration of the Arab population from Gaza.

name: Yair Lapid
role: Israeli Opposition Leader (Yesh Atid)
quote: Netanyahu had the intelligence, had the warnings, and chose not to act. The hostages are rotting in tunnels while he plays politics.

name: Emmanuel Macron
role: French President
quote: France stands with Israel in the face of terrorism. But civilians in Gaza must be protected. The images coming from Gaza are unbearable.

name: Yocheved Lifshitz
role: Israeli Hostage — Released Nov 2023 (age 85, Kibbutz Nir Oz)
quote: They took very good care of us. They brought us medicines, but what they did before taking us was very difficult.

name: Nickolay Mladenov
role: UN High Representative for Gaza (Board of Peace, 2026)
quote: We continue to engage Hamas in Cairo and Ankara. The deadline has passed but the door for agreement remains open — the cost of failure is resumed war and further suffering for Palestinians.

name: Khaled Meshaal
role: Hamas Political Bureau Chairman (2026)
quote: We submitted serious amendments to the disarmament proposal. Disarming an occupied people without a guaranteed end to occupation and a political horizon is a trap, not peace.

name: Khalil al-Hayya
role: Hamas Gaza Chief; led Hamas delegation in April 2026 Cairo Phase 2 talks; fourth son Azzam killed by IDF strike, May 7, 2026
quote: We are waiting for Mladenov to provide a clear timetable for Israel to fulfill the remaining obligations of Phase One. We will not discuss disarmament while Israel violates the ceasefire daily.

name: Aryeh Lightstone
role: US Senior Adviser; led US delegation in April 17, 2026 Cairo Phase 2 talks
quote: We expect Hamas to soon enter the disarmament process. The reconstruction of Gaza and the future of the Palestinian people depend on it.

name: Maj. Gen. Tomer Bar
role: Outgoing Israeli Air Force Commander (until May 5, 2026); called for independent Oct 7 inquiry at handover
quote: An independent investigation is vital for the IDF, for all security bodies, for the families who paid the highest price, for trust between citizens and the military, and for the state.

name: Maj. Gen. Omer Tishler
role: Israeli Air Force Commander (from May 5, 2026) — succeeded Maj. Gen. Tomer Bar; immediately integrated into Gaza war resumption planning
quote: I inherit command at a critical hour. The air force will continue to operate against all threats with precision, determination, and full capability.

name: Naftali Bennett
role: Former PM of Israel (2021–2022); formed unified electoral alliance with Lapid (announced May 11, 2026); pledged independent Oct. 7 state commission as Day 1 governing priority
quote: On Day 1 of our government, we will establish a fully independent state commission of inquiry into October 7. The families of 1,195 victims have waited 947 days. They will not wait any longer. Restoring citizens' trust in the security establishment begins with accountability.

name: Dr. Cochav Elkayam-Levy
role: Chair, Civil Commission on October 7th Crimes by Hamas; published final two-year investigation May 12, 2026, documenting systematic sexual violence including abuse of minors
quote: The sexual violence on October 7 was systematic, widespread, and integral to the attack — a calculated strategy, not spontaneous acts. Every case in our final report is cross-referenced with independent witness accounts. This documentation is essential for justice and for history.

name: MK Ariel Kallner
role: Likud MK; sponsor of coalition's October 7 inquiry bill; on May 13, 2026, a Knesset committee revealed Kallner had quietly removed 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from the bill's purpose clause, prompting opposition accusations of cover-up
quote: The change was made only for conciseness. The committee's mandate remains as robust as before. [May 13, 2026 Knesset committee — disputed by legal advisers, opposition, and bereaved family organizations who called the bill a 'political whitewash.']

name: Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir
role: IDF Chief of Staff (from Jan 2025); on May 16, 2026 confirmed killing of Izz al-Din al-Haddad, calling it 'a significant operational achievement'; toured Gaza Aug 5, 2026 vowing to bring every October 7 perpetrator to justice
quote: The IDF will continue to operate proactively. We will not allow a threat to emerge on our borders as we experienced on October 7. We will not relent until we bring every person who played a part in the massacre to justice. [August 5, 2026 — touring Gaza, saying the IDF has 'significantly weakened' Hamas and 'changed the security reality.' Earlier, May 16, 2026: 'The name of the master murderer, Iz al-Din Haddad, came up time and time again in conversations with returned hostages. Today, we succeeded in eliminating him.' — on the IDF precision strike killing al-Haddad, head of Hamas military wing and last October 7 architect in Gaza.]

name: Izz al-Din al-Haddad
role: Head of Hamas Military Wing in Gaza; member of Hamas Military Council; one of the last senior architects of the October 7 attack; captor of Nahal Oz surveillance soldiers Liri Albag, Daniela Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Naama Levy, Agam Berger; KILLED in IDF airstrike, Gaza City Rimal, May 15–16, 2026 (Day 952)
quote: I was involved in the October 7 operation. [Al Jazeera interview, citing IDF; al-Haddad acknowledged his role in October 7 planning. He joined Hamas at its founding in the late 1980s and rose to lead the military wing after Mohammed Sinwar's death, working to rebuild Hamas's military capabilities before being killed in a precision IDF strike in Gaza City, May 15–16, 2026.]

name: Mohammed Odeh
role: Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades Commander in Gaza (May 18–27, 2026); KILLED in IDF airstrike, Rimal, Gaza City, May 27, 2026 (Eid al-Adha) — 9 days after appointment; former Hamas military intelligence chief; served on Supreme Military Council during October 7 planning; appointed to succeed killed al-Haddad
quote: Hamas will continue its resistance. The occupation cannot eliminate our will to resist through assassinations. [Hamas organizational position following the killing of predecessor Haddad — Odeh himself was killed by IDF airstrike in Rimal, Gaza City on May 27, 2026, 9 days after his own appointment and 11 days after Haddad's death. Both Haddad and Odeh were senior October 7 architects targeted by the NILI campaign. Netanyahu: 'Any one who harmed Israeli citizens — we will get to him.']

name: Imad Aqel
role: Hamas 'Home Front' Logistics & Weapons Commander; born 1971, Jabaliya refugee camp; sole surviving senior Hamas figure connected to October 7 planning as of Aug 2026 — after the killings of Sinwar, Shambari, Haddad, and Odeh; NILI task force target
quote: [No public statements available — Aqel has operated in deep cover within Gaza's tunnel network, avoiding public communications. His role was preparatory: overseeing Hamas tunnel construction, weapons stockpiling, and logistical supply chains for the October 7 assault. Israel attempted to kill him in 2003 (killed associates) and bombed his Nuseirat home in 2009; he was absent both times. As of August 9, 2026 (Day 1037), he remains the last identified senior Hamas figure from the October 7 planning circle and the NILI task force's primary named target — no confirmed strike on him has been reported more than 10 weeks after Odeh's death on May 27. The Al-Qassam Brigades supreme command position remains publicly vacant; Hamas sources previously told Asharq Al-Awsat the group is weighing a 'collective leadership' model rather than naming Aqel supreme commander, to avoid making him a singular target.]

name: Michael Rabello
role: Israeli State Comptroller-designate (appointed by Netanyahu 2026, vote voided by High Court Jul 2, 2026; Knesset refused court-ordered revote); previously Netanyahu's personal defense attorney — appointment drew fierce opposition criticism as designed to install a loyalist in the oversight role legally mandated to audit government conduct before and after October 7
quote: [No accountability statement published upon appointment. The appointment of Netanyahu's personal defense lawyer as state comptroller — the official legally charged with auditing government agencies including the PM's Office, IDF, and Shin Bet on their October 7 failures — was a central grievance at the June 6, 2026 Habima Square accountability protest. On July 2, 2026, the High Court of Justice voided the Knesset vote that appointed him after ruling that several Likud lawmakers had photographed their supposedly secret ballots, and ordered a revote. On July 5, 2026, Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana confirmed he would not hold the court-ordered revote, declaring 'the Knesset has already spoken' — leaving Israel with no sitting state comptroller since that Sunday, since predecessor Matanyahu Englman's term was not extended. As of August 9, 2026, the office responsible for auditing October 7 government conduct remains vacant. Opposition parties, bereaved family organizations, and democratic watchdogs condemned the original appointment and the subsequent defiance as a systematic effort to dismantle the remaining institutional accountability mechanisms available to October 7 victims' families.]

name: Justice Isaac Amit
role: Israeli Supreme Court President (from 2024); June 4, 2026: called Haredi rioters' attack on Deputy President Sohlberg's home 'a pogrom' and 'an attack on the rule of law' — the same court he leads is scheduled to rule by July 1, 2026 on the government's October 7 investigation framework
quote: This crossed a red line. What happened last night was a pogrom — an attack on the rule of law and on the foundations of our democracy. The Supreme Court will not be intimidated. [June 4, 2026 — responding to Haredi rioters' attack on the home of Supreme Court Deputy President Noam Sohlberg; Amit is scheduled to preside over the July 1, 2026 ruling on whether the Netanyahu government has established a credible October 7 accountability framework.]

name: Justice Noam Sohlberg
role: Israeli Supreme Court Deputy President; June 3–4, 2026: Haredi rioters attacked his Alon Shvut home — smashed windows, shattered his car windshield, planted a swastika-marked flag — while he and his wife were inside; 62 arrested
quote: [No public statement released immediately following the attack. The assault on Sohlberg's home became the symbol of Haredi extremist violence against judicial institutions — occurring 27 days before the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 accountability ruling on the October 7 investigation framework. Sohlberg received Netanyahu's personal phone call of condemnation. The attack was driven by the Supreme Court's April 2026 ruling that Haredi draft exemptions were constitutionally impermissible without formal legislation.]

name: Amir Ohana
role: Knesset Speaker; rejected the High Court's call to redo the tainted state comptroller vote (Jun 21, 2026) and confirmed he would not hold the court-ordered revote (Jul 5, 2026), leaving the office that audits October 7 government conduct vacant; oversaw the Knesset's Jul 17, 2026 dissolution ahead of the Oct 27 election
quote: The Knesset has already spoken. [June 21 and July 5, 2026 — rejecting the High Court's recommendation, then formal order, to redo the tainted Michael Rabello state comptroller vote. On July 17, 2026, presiding over the Knesset's dissolution ahead of the October 27 election, Ohana called it 'the most challenging' parliament in Israeli history, citing the war's toll on bereaved and hostage families.]

name: Ruby & Hagit Chen
role: Parents of Itay Chen, Israeli-American IDF soldier taken hostage Oct 7, 2023 and later confirmed killed; lead accountability campaigners ahead of the Oct 27, 2026 election
quote: We're not standing here to ask for pity. We're here to demand answers. Are you going to form a state commission of inquiry into the events of October 7? Yes or no? Whoever is unwilling to commit to seeking the truth — we call on you not to give them your vote. [August 8, 2026 — Habima Square rally, Tel Aviv, urging voters ahead of the October 27 election to back only parties pledging a state commission of inquiry.]

name: Eyal Eshel
role: Father of Sgt. Roni Eshel, IDF lookout soldier murdered at Nahal Oz base Oct 7, 2023; conducts independent witness investigation into the attack, accountability campaigner
quote: On Shabbat, October 7, at the Nahal Oz camp, terrorists, whoever they were, were there, and they spoke and shouted at each other in Farsi. We know much more than we did before about October 7. Every day we are learning new things. [August 13, 2026 — telling KAN News that privately-collected witness testimony indicates some October 7 terrorists at Nahal Oz spoke Farsi, reinforcing intelligence assessments of Iranian proxy involvement in attack preparations.]

name: Nissim Louk
role: Father of Shani Louk, German-Israeli tattoo artist murdered at the Nova music festival Oct 7, 2023; became a prominent bereaved-family accountability voice ahead of the Oct 27, 2026 election
quote: You caused October 7! Shame on you all! Shame on Likud! My daughter Shani Louk was murdered because of you! [August 6, 2026 — confronting Transportation Minister Miri Regev at a Likud campaign stop near Jerusalem's Mahane Yehuda market. Three days later, Louk recounted publicly recognizing his daughter's leg tattoos in a friend's photo around 10:00 a.m. on October 7, 2023, before her remains were later identified via DNA.]

name: Gali Baharav-Miara
role: Attorney General of Israel; told the High Court she supports postponing a state commission of inquiry into October 7 until a new government is formed after the Oct 27 election
quote: A state commission of inquiry is clearly the most appropriate legal tool for investigating the events of October 7 and the war. It's been two years and 10 months since the war broke out and the government still hasn't made a decision. [August 19, 2026 — telling the High Court of Justice she backs delaying the commission-of-inquiry decision until after the election, even as she affirmed a commission is the right mechanism.]

name: Liad Baram
role: Father of Staff Sgt. Neta Baram, killed at the Nahal Oz military base on October 7, 2023; member of the October Council of bereaved and hostage families
quote: The state has an unceasing and unforgivable debt to investigate the circumstances and incidents that led to the largest and worst disaster since the state was founded. Instead of leadership… we come up against a wall of obtuseness and evasion of responsibility. [August 22, 2026 — addressing roughly 250 protesters at the weekly Habima Square rally in Tel Aviv demanding a state commission of inquiry.]
